product.name: BeautifulRepo
product.description: Guides and examples for clear, useful software repositories.

audience: Developers writing a README for a command-line tool

changes.text: Added a source-backed guide for command-line repository READMEs.
Added a runnable, dependency-free CSV row-counting example with black-box tests.
The guide distinguishes a source invocation from an installable or released package and links to official GitHub and Python Packaging guidance.
These are educational materials, not a published CLI package or cross-platform certification.

cta_text: Read the CLI documentation guide in BeautifulRepo.
